correctness.rationale: All 16383 nonzero binary plane-filling quintics are enumerated. For 14871 excluded equations an actual gradient-zero point is exhibited in extensions of degree at most 6. The remaining 1512 form exactly ten rational projective orbits, and on every representative each standard affine chart has derivative ideal (1), computed by exact Gröbner bases over F2. This certifies smoothness over the algebraic closure and completes the classification. The packaged standalone code was executed and passed.
